blocks.text: The SDLC is an organized method for developing software that ensures it meets quality standards and functions properly. It is used by software developers and engineers to guide the design, development, and testing of software. The SDLC consists of several steps as shown in Figure 1.1. Each step has distinct tasks and goals.

blocks.alt: Six green boxes step down from left to right like stairs: Requirement, Analysis, Design, Coding/Implementation, Testing and Maintenance, each with a small icon. A green arrow leads from each box down into the next. A line runs back from Maintenance along the bottom and rises into the left side of every earlier box.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.1: System development life cycle stages (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 1.1).
